description: baseline: LightGBM binary classifier with Optuna TPE search (60 trials, 5-fold stratified CV) over num_leaves, learning_rate, min_child_samples, feature_fraction, bagging, L1/L2, max_depth — chosen because N=500 with 11 mixed features is squarely in Tier A where gradient boosting dominates; missing indicators added for high-miss columns, categorical features passed natively to LightGBM.

Rich Titanic feature engineering: drop PassengerId, extract Title from Name, add FamilySize/IsAlone, HasCabin/Deck, FareLog/FarePerPerson, IsChild/AgePclass, SexPclass, TicketFreq — replacing noisy ordinal-encoded IDs with meaningful signals, and increase Optuna to 80 trials

Enhanced feature engineering (smart Age imputation by Title+Pclass group, ticket prefix, age bins, family size groups, IsMother/IsAdultMale flags, surname frequency) + added XGBoost with 30 Optuna trials and blended 50/50 with LightGBM (60 trials) for model diversity
Add CatBoost (20 Optuna trials) with seed ensemble (5 seeds) blended with LightGBM (60 trials, 10-seed ensemble), using CV-AUC-weighted blend for genuine model diversity on the small Titanic dataset
Smart Age imputation by Title+Pclass group (fixes IsChild/AgePclass computed on NaN), add IsAdultMale/IsMother/FamilyGroup/AgeBin features, increase CatBoost trials to 30
Add XGBoost (20 Optuna trials, 5-seed ensemble) as third model, add SurnameFreq feature (family group signal), and blend all three models with CV-AUC weights for greater diversity

Replace CV-AUC weighted blend with OOF-based LogisticRegression stacking meta-learner: generates out-of-fold predictions from LGBM+CatBoost on training set, trains LR to find optimal combination, applies it to seed-ensemble val predictions for final AUC

Add CabinSide (port/starboard from cabin number parity) and FareRankByClass (fare percentile within Pclass) features; add XGBoost (15 Optuna trials, 5-seed ensemble) as 3rd model in OOF stacking; tune meta-learner C via inner CV on OOF predictions
Add WomenChild flag (sex/age combined), TitlePclass interaction, FarePerPersonLog features, and increase Optuna trials (LGBM 60→80, CatBoost 30→40) for better hyperparameter coverage

Add SurnameFreq feature (family group survival signal), OOF target encoding for Title/SexPclass/TitlePclass (smoothed survival rate per category, leak-free via 5-fold), and inner-CV meta-learner C tuning to find optimal LR regularization

Add RandomForestClassifier (20 Optuna trials, 5-seed ensemble) as 3rd model in OOF stacking — RF uses bagging instead of boosting, producing less-correlated predictions than LGBM/CatBoost and giving the meta-learner more diverse signal

Fix SyntaxError from exp 10, start fresh from best_train.py (exp 8), and add SVM (RBF kernel) as a 3rd stacking model — SVM has fundamentally different inductive bias from LGBM/CatBoost (kernel-based, maximum margin vs. tree-based boosting), with per-fold StandardScaler to avoid leakage, 15 Optuna trials to find best C/gamma, and included in the OOF meta-learner alongside LGBM+CatBoost.

Restore exp 8's full configuration (LGBM 80 trials + CatBoost 40 trials, 5-fold CV, 10+5 seed ensembles, LGBM+CatBoost OOF stacking) and add three new interaction features: EmbarkedSex (Embarked×Sex captures 1st-class women from Cherbourg's ~97% survival), EmbarkedPclass (Embarked×Pclass captures class-stratified port effects), and SurnameFreq (family group proxy via surname frequency in training set)

Switch Optuna search from 5-fold to 3-fold CV enabling 120 LGBM trials (vs 80) and 60 CatBoost trials (vs 40) in the same time budget — more hyperparameter coverage with proven LGBM+CatBoost OOF stacking from exp 8 unchanged

Restore exp 8's proven LGBM+CatBoost OOF stacking (80+40 Optuna trials, 5-fold CV, 10+5 seed ensembles, LR meta-learner) and add FareRankByClass — within-Pclass fare percentile rank computed leak-free from training data, capturing relative wealth within class independently of raw Fare/FareLog/FarePerPerson features

Add OOF TicketGroupSurvival (leak-free target encoding by ticket group capturing whether travel companions survived) and WomenChildPclass (explicit class×women/child survival gradient interaction) features to the proven LGBM+CatBoost OOF stacking from exp 14

Add OOF SurnameSurvivalRate feature — leak-free target encoding by passenger surname (extracted from Name before engineer() drops it), capturing family-level survival correlation for related passengers who may share last names but hold different tickets, complementing TicketGroupSurvival from exp 15

Add ChildPclass (IsChild × (4-Pclass)) and AdultMalePclass (IsAdultMale × (4-Pclass)) features capturing class-stratified survival rates for children (100% in 1st/2nd vs 34% in 3rd) and adult males (37% vs 15%), complementing WomenChildPclass which conflates children and adult women

Enrich OOF stacking meta-learner with 3 additional features: product term (lgbm_oof×cat_oof adds nonlinearity LR can't learn from base inputs alone), WomenChild (domain anchor for correcting systematic mispredictions on women/children), and TicketGroupSurvival (group-level anchor for confused individual predictions) — all with C=1.0 regularization on N=712 training samples

Expand meta-learner from 5 to 10 features by adding model×subgroup interactions (lgbm*WC, cat*WC, lgbm*TGS, cat*TGS, WC*TGS) enabling subgroup-specific model weighting, plus inner-CV C tuning over 9 values for optimal regularization

Add shallow GBM (LightGBM) meta-learner tuned via 30-trial Optuna inner CV as second stacker alongside LR, blend with inner-CV-AUC weights — GBM discovers nonlinear/3-way interactions among the 10 meta-features that LR's explicit products cannot capture

Extend meta-learner from 10 to 17 features by adding lgbm²/cat² (quadratic calibration), signed model disagreement (lgbm-cat), IsAlone (solo-traveler survival anchor), Pclass_norm (strongest raw predictor directly in meta), and LGBM×Pclass/Cat×Pclass (class-stratified model calibration); also expand inner-CV C grid from 9 to 12 values to handle stronger regularization needs

Add 2-seed OOF averaging (seeds 42 and 123) to reduce variance in base model OOF predictions — each training sample gets predicted from two different 80% training subsets, averaged before meta-learner training, giving the LR stacker a cleaner signal with ~+10s runtime cost

Add XGBoost as 3rd stacking base model (20 Optuna trials, 5 seeds, 8 hyperparams tuned) alongside reduced LGBM/CatBoost trials (70/35), extending meta-learner from 10 to 13 features with symmetric xgb_oof + xgb*WC + xgb*TGS interactions — XGBoost's weight-regularized L1/L2 provides orthogonal predictions vs tree-split-based LGBM/CatBoost within the now-richer meta-learner that can properly leverage a 3rd diverse model

Add TicketPrefix categorical feature (booking class/agent signal) and replace binary WomenChild with normalized WomenChildPclass (4-level class-stratified anchor) in meta-learner for finer calibration across survival subgroups

Transform base model OOF/val predictions to logit (log-odds) space before LR meta-learner + add StandardScaler (via Pipeline for C tuning, standalone for final fit) so L2 regularization applies uniformly across features of very different scales — the LR meta-learner is theoretically optimal in logit space and scale-equalized regularization gives C tuning a cleaner objective.

Add Pclass_norm=(4-Pclass)/3 and its interactions with both base model logit predictions (lgbm_l×Pclass, cat_l×Pclass) to the meta-learner (10→13 features) — WomenChildPclass only provides class signal for women/children but adult males (1st class ~37% vs 3rd class ~15% survival) had no direct Pclass anchor in the meta-learner; these 3 features close that calibration gap with zero runtime cost.

Expand meta-learner from 13→19 features by adding HasCabin (binary cabin-presence anchor, ~60% vs 30% survival) and FareRankByClass (within-class wealth percentile) as domain anchors plus their interactions with both base model logits — these are strong predictors in base models but not yet explicit calibration signals in the meta-learner, targeting residual errors for VIP 1st-class passengers and high-fare outliers.

Switch meta-learner from Ridge to Elastic Net (penalty='elasticnet', solver='saga'), jointly tuning C×l1_ratio over a 9×7=63-point grid — Elastic Net is strictly more general than Ridge (l1_ratio=0 recovers Ridge), and L1 can zero out any of the 13 meta-features that add noise rather than signal, with no other changes to the proven exp 26 base configuration.

Switch OOF stacking from 5-fold to 10-fold (reduces OOF bias — each fold model trains on 90% vs 80% of data, closing the gap with full-data val models) and add IsAlone as 14th meta-learner feature (disambiguates solo travelers from group members with val-only companions, where both have TGS=mean); also expand C-tuning grid from 9 to 12 values.

Add `rsm` (random subspace/feature fraction) to CatBoost Optuna search + expand depth/l2/border_count ranges for better base model quality; add FareRankByClass as isolated 14th meta-feature (without interactions, unlike exp 27 which tried it with HasCabin + 6 extra terms → 19 features); finer C-tuning grid (9→12 values) around the likely optimal range.

Add rsm (feature fraction per split, 0.5-1.0) to CatBoost Optuna search + expand depth/l2/border_count ranges, keeping exp 26's proven 13-feature logit meta-learner unchanged — isolating the CatBoost search improvement from exp 30 which confounded it with the harmful FareRankByClass meta-feature

Add IsFemale + model×IsFemale interactions (13→16 meta-features) to separate adult-female calibration from WCPclass which conflates women+children, enabling the meta-learner to recalibrate predictions for female passengers independently of the child/class signal

Replace full-train seed ensemble with fold-model val predictions (distributional consistency: meta-learner trained on 80%-trained OOF logits now applied to 80%-trained fold-model val logits instead of 100%-trained logits); use saved ~30s for more Optuna trials (LGBM 80→100, CatBoost 40→55)

Add SVM (RBF kernel) meta-learner alongside existing LR meta-learner, blend predictions by inner-CV-AUC weights — SVM can capture nonlinear relationships in the 13-dimensional logit-space meta-features that LR's linear combination misses, at near-zero runtime cost since SVM on N=712 with 30 grid points × 5-fold CV is milliseconds

Add LightGBM monotone constraints encoding known Titanic survival relationships (Pclass, Fare, WomenChild, IsAdultMale, HasCabin, TGS, IsAlone) using domain knowledge to regularize the model on the small N=712 dataset, using advanced constraint enforcement method

Add 2-seed OOF averaging (seeds 42+123) to reduce fold-assignment variance in the logit-space meta-learner training signal — averaging LGBM/CatBoost OOF predictions from two independent 5-fold partitions before the logit transform, keeping exp 26's proven 13-feature meta-learner unchanged; this was untried with the logit-space meta-learner (exp 22 only tested it pre-logit-space).

Run two independent LGBM Optuna studies (seeds 42+99, 60 trials each = 120 configs) and two CatBoost studies (seeds 123+456, 30+20 = 50 configs) to broaden hyperparameter space coverage by exploring different regions; take the best params from each pair — gives better coverage than single-seed 80+40 with same time budget.

Multi-seed OOF averaging within the same fold split (3 seeds per fold: 42/0/1) to match the val ensemble's lower variance distribution, avoiding the cross-split contamination that hurt exp 36 (which used different fold splits where training samples could appear in multiple folds' training sets)

Add TicketNumberLog feature (log of ticket's numeric portion) to base models — ticket numbers encode booking class/order (110xxx=1st class vs 3101xxx=3rd class), complementary to the categorical TicketPrefix, providing a continuous ordering signal within prefix groups while keeping exp 26's proven 13-feature logit meta-learner unchanged.

Add TicketGroupFemaleRatio and TicketGroupChildRatio to base models: group-level passenger composition from features-only (no labels → no leakage even using combined train+val), filling the gap where TicketGroupSurvival defaults to the training mean for val passengers whose whole group is in val

Add ExtraTrees as 3rd base model in OOF stacking (random feature+threshold selection for genuine diversity from LGBM/CatBoost), extending logit-space meta-learner from 13→16 features with et_l + et_l×WCPclass + et_l×Pclass interactions

Add TGS×Pclass_norm as 14th meta-learner feature — the only missing first-order cross between domain anchors (captures class-stratified trust in ticket group survival signal: 1st class groups are more reliable than 3rd class groups with equal TGS)

Add IsAlone as 15th logit-space meta-learner feature — disambiguates solo travelers (TGS=training mean by default) from group members, which exp 29's IsAlone attempt conflated with a harmful simultaneous 10-fold CV change

Add two 3-way meta-learner interactions (lgbm_logit×TGS×Pclass_norm and cat_logit×TGS×Pclass_norm) as 15th/16th features — genuine higher-order signals that LR can't construct from existing 2-way terms — and expand C grid from 9 to 15 values with finer resolution in the 0.1–2.0 range

Add HasCabin as 15th meta-learner feature (orthogonal VIP-status anchor not captured by TGS/Pclass_norm), use multivariate TPE for both base model Optuna searches (models joint hyperparameter distributions for better search quality), and expand C grid from 9→12 values for finer regularization tuning with 15 features

Add DeckOrdinal (preserves A→G ordinal ordering lost in LabelEncoding) and CabinNumber (numeric cabin portion as fore-aft position proxy) to base model features — both novel signals not captured by existing Deck+HasCabin, keeping exp42's proven 14-feature meta-learner intact

Add sklearn MLPClassifier meta-learner (L-BFGS, 20-config grid search over hidden size + L2 regularization via 5-fold inner-CV) on the 14-feature logit-space inputs, blended 50/50 with existing LR meta-learner only when MLP inner-CV AUC is competitive (within 0.005 of LR), to capture non-linear patterns in the meta-feature space that LR's linear combination misses

Add WCPclass×Pclass_norm as 15th meta-learner feature — the only missing 2-way cross among domain anchors {WCPclass, TGS, Pclass_norm} — capturing quadratic Pclass effect for WC passengers to sharpen 1st vs 3rd class women/children calibration

Fix truncated train.py from exp 48 and add XGBoost shallow meta-learner (depth 2-3, 12-config grid) alongside LR in logit space — tree-based threshold interactions that LR's explicit product terms can't model, blended by inner-CV AUC weight

Apply logit transform to TicketGroupSurvival in meta-learner (TGS is a survival probability, so log-odds space amplifies extreme group signals like all-survived/all-died, matching the treatment of base model outputs; fixes truncated train.py from exp 49)

Add LogisticRegression as 3rd base model in OOF stacking (numeric features + StandardScaler + tuned C), adding its logit as 15th meta-learner feature — LR's smooth linear probability gradients provide fundamentally different inductive bias from LGBM/CatBoost's tree-based thresholds, capturing different survival contours for passengers at class/sex/age decision boundaries

Increase Optuna trial budget by 50% (80→120 LGBM, 40→55 CatBoost) using faster per-trial evaluations (400 max rounds vs 600, es=30 vs 40) for same wall-clock cost, while keeping final OOF/val model quality unchanged — more hyperparameter configurations explored may find a better region.

Add OOF SexPclass survival rate as 15th meta-learner feature — provides direct calibration anchor for each of 6 sex×class demographic groups (female_1~97%, male_3~15%), complementing WCPclass+Pclass_norm which linearly reconstruct but can't perfectly separate male_1 vs male_3 since WCPclass=0 for all adult males.

Add MLPClassifier as 3rd base model in OOF stacking alongside LGBM+CatBoost — MLP's smooth neural activations have fundamentally different inductive bias from tree splits, providing orthogonal signal; use 8-config grid search for best architecture, 3-seed OOF averaging per fold for stability, 5-seed val ensemble, and add mlp_oof_l as sole 15th meta-learner feature (no interactions, to limit overfitting risk on N=712 meta training samples).

Add |lgbm_logit - cat_logit| (absolute disagreement) as 15th meta-learner feature — this is a nonlinear uncertainty signal LR cannot reconstruct from existing features (which can represent the signed difference but not its absolute value), allowing the meta-learner to down-weight confidence when base models strongly disagree and rely more on domain anchors.

Replace single-best-C LR meta-learner with a C-ensemble: train LR for all 15 C values in an expanded grid [0.01…10], weight-average val predictions using softmax(T=10) of inner-CV AUCs — Bayesian model averaging over hyperparameter uncertainty to reduce sensitivity to grid resolution and noisy C selection; all base model code identical to exp 42 (best_train.py).
